caption: The video captures a daytime outdoor scene where a brush-and-log bonfire is already burning on a mowed green lawn. A pile of split wood and branches sits on blackened ground, while bright orange flames cover the center and right side. The flames flicker continuously, changing height, shape, and brightness without leaving their location on the pile. A thick white-gray smoke column rises from the left edge of the fire, billowing upward and drifting left. As the scene progresses, wisps detach and swirl near the top, and the plume bends farther left across the air above the trees. The wood pile, charred ground, foreground grass, and background tree line remain in place. No collapse or rearrangement of the logs is visible, and no people or animals enter the frame. Evergreens, autumn-colored trees, and one bare tree stand beneath a clear blue sky while the burning continues.
